subject: MD-100 midterm sim: 'Disable Lock Screen ads via Registry' rejects reg add, and shows a wrong registry path
description:
Hit by the operator doing the lab: 24/25, stuck on Phase 3 Task 5. TWO issues in _app/houses/forge/md-100/labs/forge-md100-midterm-sim.lab.html.

1. The terminal parser has 27 commands and 'reg' is not one of them (grep: no cmdName === 'reg'). Only Set-ItemProperty satisfies objective c5. But the objective text says 'via Registry', and 'reg add HKCU\...\ContentDeliveryManager /v RotatingLockScreenEnabled /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f' is the idiomatic cmd.exe form that MD-100 material and Microsoft docs commonly use. A student typing the exam-correct cmd syntax gets silence and concludes their answer is wrong. Fix: add a 'reg' branch that accepts 'reg add' with /v RotatingLockScreenEnabled and /d 0, setting state.registry.lockScreenAds = false, and 'reg delete' likewise. Mirror the existing Set-ItemProperty branch at the parser's registry section.

2. The Registry Tweaks toggle subtitle reads HKCU\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\ContentDeliveryManager\RotatingLockScreenEnabled. The real path is HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ContentDeliveryManager - 'CurrentVersion' is missing. In a cert-prep lab that is a detail students memorise, so it is worth correcting even though nothing functional depends on it.

Working answer for anyone stuck meanwhile: Set-ItemProperty -Path "HKCU:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ContentDeliveryManager" -Name RotatingLockScreenEnabled -Value 0 (parser needs only the cmdlet name, the string rotatinglockscreen or contentdeliverymanager, and -Value 0). Or flip the GUI toggle, which starts on.
[2026-09-03 16:27] STATUS 2026-09-03 after the Terminal.js await fix.

PROVEN: the [object Promise] bug is gone. Verified across all 10 NT boxes by driving each in a browser; reverting only the await turns 6 of 10 red with the string present. That was almost certainly the whole reason the class saw nothing at the documented flag location: the ipconfig output containing the flag was being replaced by the string wholesale.

NOT PROVEN, and I could not determine it: whether the flag now actually appears at each scenario's documented location. Ten legitimate plays (flushdns then ping then displaydns, real UI, server stubbed) produced no reveal. That is INCONCLUSIVE rather than negative: the scenario is 1-in-5 random, so ~11% chance I never drew dns_poisoned in ten tries.

THE REAL BLOCKER, and it is a testability gap worth its own fix: the box exposes NO globals (no engine, no NT1Config on window, verified), so a test cannot force a scenario or inspect state. A box whose scenario is random AND whose state is unreachable cannot be gated at all - every verification is a coin flip repeated until someone gets bored. Any future NT-series work should add a test-only scenario hook.

DESIGN NOTE, corrected from an earlier wrong conclusion of mine: NT1's flags are NOT missing. requestFlagText() fetches them server-side via the deliverFlag callable, which is the correct secure pattern, and _scenarioFlags holding five nulls is vestigial rather than broken. My earlier reading that 'there is no flag' came from a four-week-old flag-registry BACKUP rather than the live Firestore registry, and the operator's class disproved it by submitting successfully.

FASTEST PATH TO CLOSING THIS: one play of the box by someone who can see the scenario. Fix the network, then check the location the hint names. Thirty seconds of a human beats another twenty automated attempts.
[2026-09-04 13:54] FIXED. Registry path corrected (CurrentVersion was missing; the lab's own PS example already had it right). Vote 3-1 AGAINST wiring reg.exe up to grade; instead the fallback now TRANSLATES the typed cmd.exe command into its PowerShell equivalent, the banner states the scope up front, and Get-Help gained the lock-screen example (its only example was fDenyTSConnections, a different setting -- the real dead end). Chris dissented for grading reg.exe; his point that the Settings toggle already satisfies c5 without PowerShell is why c5 was NOT reworded. Browser-verified 7/7. Spawned BUG-256.
